items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Why was it that John went right to the mike and forgot that I named that tune after him when he was sitting in the audience?

ctx.x: Why was it that John went right to the mike and forgot that I named that tune after him when he was sitting in the audience? When we was rehearsing John's idea? And they asked him, how did it get its title? He said, well, it was a little thing that they just called John's Idea, for some reason. He never did say why. He never did say it was my tune. And the reason I brought it up, because four or five guys called me up about it. Couple of white guys called me, called me the next day, why didn't he say nothing…
